about.title: About
bio: I'm Samuel, 24 years old, I love soccer and Botafogo, and I'm a technology enthusiast.
Computer science graduate and master's student in computer science, focusing on information systems and databases.
I've been working as a software engineer for over 4 years, mostly on the back-end with Java and C# and on the front-end and mobile with React and React Native.
I've also worked on AI projects, and I use AI and agents in my day-to-day development workflow.
